已保存到角色场景卡，可在酒馆制作中载入或导出: Saved as a scenario card. Load or export it in Tavern creator.
玩家入场自动发布开场白，发言后自动调用 AI。自动回复在后台运行；主持人可随时暂: Post an opening when a player joins and call AI after player messages. Replies run in the background; the host can pause or take over at any time.
自动主持只使用公开场景、已发布资料、规则名称和对话。秘密与线索请由主持人按进度发: Automatic narration uses only the public scene, published handouts, rules label and conversation. The host decides when to reveal secrets and clues.
此处可手动预览回复。切换 AI 角色后，点击应用自动互动设置以更新后台角色。: Preview a reply manually here. After selecting another AI character, apply automation settings to update the background character.
把当前角色、收藏角色、场景、开场白和世界书保存为一套可复用的场景卡。: Save the current character, saved cast, scene, opening and worldbook as a reusable scenario card.
载入将替换当前角色草稿和世界书，并把场景内角色加入收藏；现有收藏会保留。: Loading replaces the current character draft and worldbook, and adds the cast to your library. Existing saved cards are kept.
跑团资料不能超过 2 MB: Adventure files must not exceed 2 MB
请选择 TRPG 副本 JSON 或世界观导出 JSON: Choose a TRPG module JSON or exported world JSON
支持 JSON、TXT 和 Markdown 文件: Supports JSON, TXT and Markdown files
根据已有设定和随机种子生成世界与副本；留空时自由随机。预设为原创、无系统短篇，可: Generate a world and adventure from existing lore and a seed, or invent freely if empty. Presets are original system-neutral one-shots you can adapt to your rules.
支持副本 JSON、世界观导出 JSON、TXT、Markdown。文本资料先载: Supports adventure JSON, exported world JSON, TXT and Markdown. Text files are loaded into the GM scene draft and are not automatically made public.
载入会替换备团草稿，并同步设定到世界观；实际跑团记录会保留。副本同时加入本项目副: Loading replaces preparation drafts and adds settings to the world. Actual session logs are kept. The adventure is also saved to this project's library.
无系统叙事；2–5 人，约 2–3 小时。检定难度由主持人按所用规则换算。: System-neutral narrative; 2–5 players, about 2–3 hours. The GM adapts checks to their chosen rules.
山村每天黄昏都会听到废弃钟楼的钟声。昨夜，一队采药人走进雾中，至今没有回来。: Every dusk, a deserted bell tower rings above a mountain village. Last night a party of herbalists entered the mist and never returned.
村长请求救援；古物学者悬赏寻找钟楼铭文；一名失踪者是玩家的旧友。: The village elder asks for rescuers; an antiquarian offers payment for a tower inscription; a missing herbalist is an old friend.
村口：询问目击者。雾林：沿脚印或溪流抵达遗迹。钟楼：修复机关、谈判或破坏钟摆都能: Village entrance: interview witnesses. Mistwood: follow tracks or the stream to the ruins. Tower: repair the mechanism, negotiate or break the pendulum to free the trapped party.
村长岚：急于救人。守钟灵：履行被误解的约定。采药人青：知道安全的小路。: Elder Lan wants a quick rescue. The bell spirit follows a misunderstood pact. Herbalist Qing knows a safe trail.
泥脚印、采药人的绳结、溪边回声都能指向钟楼；铭文可通过拓印、询问守灵或拼合石片解: Muddy tracks, herbalists' knots and echoes along the stream all point to the tower. Read the inscription with a rubbing, ask the spirit or piece together stone fragments.
藤蔓阻路可以绕行、砍开或协作攀越。失控钟摆可停机、引开或以盾抵挡；失败带来耗时或: Blocked vines can be bypassed, cut or climbed together. Stop, distract or shield against the pendulum. Failure costs time or equipment without preventing rescue.
钟楼保护的是村庄水源；钟声将迷路者聚到安全地。商人私拆齿轮造成迷雾，归还齿轮即可: The tower protects the village water supply; its ringing guides lost travelers to safety. A merchant removed a gear and caused the mist. Returning it restores the mechanism.
无系统调查；2–5 人，约 2–3 小时。关键线索无需一次检定成功才能取得。: System-neutral investigation; 2–5 players, about 2–3 hours. Essential clues never depend on passing a single check.
暴雨封路，旅馆的客人被困一夜。午夜过后，所有收音机同时播出了一位失踪旅客的求助。: Heavy rain strands the inn's guests overnight. After midnight, every radio broadcasts a missing traveler's plea for help.
调查失踪案；护送一名旅客；修复旅馆的通信设备。: Investigate a disappearance, escort a traveler or repair the inn's communications.
大厅收集证言；客房检查行李；地下机房寻找广播来源。顺序自由，时间推进会令积水上涨: Gather testimony in the lobby, inspect luggage upstairs and trace the broadcast in the basement. Explore in any order as floodwater rises.
店主苏：隐瞒债务。修理工白：害怕被怀疑。旅客林：保留了异常录音。: Innkeeper Su hides debts. Mechanic Bai fears suspicion. Traveler Lin kept a recording of the broadcast.
入住登记、湿脚印和一张修理单均指向旧机房；钥匙可借取、复制或从通风口绕入。: The guest register, wet footprints and a repair slip all lead to the old machine room. Borrow or copy a key, or enter through a vent.
停电与涨水造成时间压力。沟通失败可用证物佐证；搜索失败仍得到线索但消耗照明。: Power cuts and rising water create time pressure. Support failed interviews with evidence. Failed searches still reveal clues but consume light.
失踪旅客被困隔音储藏室，求助来自自制定时发射器。店主为躲债封门，未发现有人在内。: The missing traveler is trapped in a soundproof store room, using a homemade timed transmitter. The innkeeper sealed it to evade creditors without noticing anyone inside. Resolve through rescue, exposure or negotiation.
无系统求生；2–5 人，约 2–3 小时。由主持人记录氧气与能源，AI 只提供叙: System-neutral survival; 2–5 players, about 2–3 hours. The GM tracks oxygen and power; AI provides narrative suggestions only.
货船在废弃空间站附近失去动力。救援窗口只剩三小时，空间站还在发出断续的引导信号。: A freighter loses power near an abandoned station. The rescue window closes in three hours while an intermittent signal still guides ships toward the station.
寻找燃料；救出信号发出者；保住船上的冷藏样本。: Find fuel, rescue the signal's sender and preserve the ship's refrigerated samples.
气闸选择供能方式；生态舱寻找资源；控制室修复信标。可分头行动，但通信有延迟。: Choose an airlock power source, search the habitat for resources and repair the beacon in control. The party can split up, but communications are delayed.
维护机器人七号：严格遵守节能程序。工程师墨：困在冷却舱。救援船长：需要准确坐标。: Maintenance robot Seven strictly follows energy-saving procedures. Engineer Mo is trapped in the cooling bay. The rescue captain needs precise coordinates.
维修日志、电缆温度和七号的记录都指向冷却故障；坐标可从导航缓存、星图或外部天线恢: Maintenance logs, cable temperatures and Seven's records indicate a cooling fault. Recover coordinates from navigation caches, star charts or the external antenna.
失压舱可封堵、绕道或短暂穿越。有限电池可用于通信或生命维持；行动前说明可见代价，: Seal, bypass or briefly cross a depressurized compartment. Limited batteries power communications or life support. Explain visible costs before the players choose.
引导信号来自工程师的手动开关。反应堆未爆炸，只是保护停机；救人后可低功率重启，也: The engineer operates the beacon manually. The reactor has shut down safely, not exploded. Rescue the engineer and restart it at low power, or abandon the station.
生成的设定自动显示在世界观中，标记为 AI 待确认；采纳后转为正式设定。: Generated settings appear in worldbuilding as AI pending review. Accept them to confirm the settings.

收藏包含角色卡及其世界书。载入前会预览；联机时可分别选择 AI 角色。: Each saved character includes its worldbook. Preview before loading, and choose individual AI speakers in LAN rooms.
